latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Video to Audio skill — extract audio from video files easily.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files (up to 500MB) and extract audio tracks as MP3 in seconds.
- No installation or complex setup required; automatic backend session and token management.
- Clear user commands for uploading files, checking credits, export, and status tracking.
- Real-time cloud processing: audio extraction via remote GPU with timely feedback.
- Supports multiple workflows: quick single file, batch, and iterative editing sessions.
- Helpful prompts, clear status updates, and error handling for smooth user experience.
